Lunar Flames 🔥🌙

We are a team of passionate innovators exploring the intersection of space science, artificial intelligence, and technology. Driven by curiosity and creativity, we aim to turn complex scientific challenges into meaningful solutions.

For NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are focused on exploring fire behavior in microgravity and leveraging AI and data-driven insights to support better understanding of fire safety beyond Earth.

Igniting Innovation Beyond Gravity.🔥🚀
